SUBCONTRACT AGREEMENT

This Subcontract Agreement (this "Subcontract") is made as of April 6, 2026 between Larkspur Construction Group, Inc., an Ohio corporation ("Contractor"), and Vanterra Mechanical Services, LLC, an Ohio limited liability company ("Subcontractor"), for work on the Ridgeline Aerospace Facility Expansion located at 2100 Foundry Lane, Waterbury, Ohio (the "Project"), owned by Ridgeline Aerospace Components, Inc. ("Owner").

1. Scope of Work.

Subcontractor shall furnish all labor, materials, equipment, and services necessary to perform the mechanical, HVAC, and process-piping work described in Exhibit A (the "Work"), in accordance with the Contract Documents. The Contract Documents consist of the prime contract between Contractor and Owner, the drawings and specifications listed in Exhibit B, and all addenda and change orders. Subcontractor acknowledges that it has reviewed the Contract Documents and assumes toward Contractor all obligations that Contractor assumes toward Owner with respect to the Work.

2. Subcontract Price.

Contractor shall pay Subcontractor the lump sum of Two Million Four Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($2,450,000), subject to additions and deductions for changes in the Work.

3. Progress Payments.

Subcontractor shall submit an application for payment by the 25th day of each month for Work completed through that date. Contractor shall pay Subcontractor within seven (7) days after Contractor receives payment from Owner for the Work. Receipt of payment by Contractor from Owner is a condition precedent to Contractor's obligation to pay Subcontractor, and Subcontractor assumes the risk of Owner's nonpayment.

4. Retainage.

Contractor shall retain ten percent (10%) of each progress payment until Final Completion of the Work and receipt of the corresponding retainage from Owner.

5. Changes in the Work.

Contractor may order changes in the Work. Subcontractor shall proceed with a change upon written direction from Contractor, and the parties shall thereafter negotiate an equitable adjustment. No claim for an adjustment will be considered unless Subcontractor gives Contractor written notice within five (5) days after the event giving rise to the claim.

6. Schedule; Delay.

Time is of the essence. Subcontractor shall perform the Work in accordance with Contractor's schedule as it may be revised from time to time. Subcontractor shall be liable for all costs and damages, including liquidated damages assessed against Contractor by Owner, arising from Subcontractor's delay. Subcontractor shall have no claim for damages arising from delay caused by Contractor, Owner, or any other party, and its sole remedy for any delay is an extension of time.

7. Indemnification.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Subcontractor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Contractor, Owner, and their respective officers, directors, agents, and employees from and against all claims, damages, losses, and expenses, including attorneys' fees, arising out of or resulting from performance of the Work, regardless of whether such claim is caused in part by a party indemnified hereunder.

8. Insurance.

Subcontractor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence and $4,000,000 aggregate, automobile liability of $1,000,000, workers' compensation as required by law, and umbrella coverage of $5,000,000. Contractor and Owner shall be named as additional insureds on a primary and non-contributory basis, and Subcontractor waives all rights of subrogation against them.

9. Lien Waivers.

With each application for payment, Subcontractor shall deliver an unconditional waiver and release of lien for all Work through the date of the prior payment, and a conditional waiver for the current application. Subcontractor waives and releases any right to file or maintain a mechanic's lien against the Project, and agrees that its sole remedy is against Contractor.

10. Termination for Convenience.

Contractor may terminate this Subcontract for its convenience upon written notice. Upon such termination, Subcontractor shall be paid for Work performed to the date of termination, and shall have no claim for anticipated profit or overhead on Work not performed.

11. Default.

If Subcontractor fails to supply sufficient skilled workers or materials, or otherwise breaches this Subcontract, Contractor may, after twenty-four (24) hours written notice, take over and complete the Work by any means and charge the cost to Subcontractor.

12. Dispute Resolution.

Any dispute arising out of or relating to this Subcontract shall be resolved in the manner provided in the prime contract, at Contractor's sole election, and Subcontractor shall be bound by any determination made in a proceeding between Contractor and Owner in which Subcontractor has been given notice and an opportunity to participate.

13. Governing Law.

This Subcontract is governed by the laws of the State of Ohio.

14. No Third-Party Beneficiaries.

Nothing in this Subcontract creates any right in favor of any person not a party to it, except that Owner is an intended third-party beneficiary of Subcontractor's obligations.

LARKSPUR CONSTRUCTION GROUP, INC.
